name: Crystal Garden
desc: Plant crystal seeds and tend a glittering garden that grows while you watch. Larger crystals are worth far more points, but let one grow too long and it will crack. Learn when to harvest and when to wait.

name: Color Mixer
desc: A target color appears on screen and it's up to you to recreate it. Slide the red, green and blue channels until the swatches line up as closely as you can. The closer your match, the more points you earn.

name: Fishing Hole
desc: Cast your line into still water and wait for the bobber to dip. Reel in at exactly the right moment to land the catch, because rarer fish pay out much more. A relaxed game of patience and timing.

name: Dot Connect
desc: Numbered dots are scattered across the board, waiting to be linked. Draw a path from one to the last in order without ever crossing your own line. Complete the shape to win.

name: Slide Puzzle
desc: Slide numbered tiles around a 4x4 grid using the single empty space until everything sits in order. It rewards planning several moves ahead, and the fewer moves you use, the higher your score.

name: Idle Farm
desc: Plant seeds, water your crops and harvest them when they ripen. Each crop grows on its own schedule, so deciding what to plant and when decides your final haul. Manage your field well before the round ends.

name: REACTION TEST
desc: Wait for the screen to turn green, then react as fast as you can. Over five rounds your average reaction time is measured, and the lower the better. Jump the gun and the round is lost.

name: ZEN GARDEN
desc: Rake patterns into the sand and place stones to match the target layout. A slow, soothing puzzle with no timer and nothing to rush.

name: TOWER OF HANOI
desc: A timeless logic puzzle. Move a stack of rings to the far peg one at a time, never placing a larger ring on a smaller one. Simple rules, with surprisingly deep planning.

name: SLIDE PUZZLE
desc: Slide numbered tiles around a 4x4 grid using the single empty space until everything sits in order. It rewards planning several moves ahead, and the fewer moves you use, the higher your score.

name: MINE SWEEPER
desc: A field of hidden mines is waiting, and numbered clues are your only guide. Reason through the numbers and flag every mine without setting one off. Pure logic with no clock pressure.

name: MAZE WEAVER
desc: Each maze is freshly woven, so no two runs are the same. Trace your path through twisting corridors and dead ends to find the exit, and take all the time you want.

name: DOMINO CASCADE
desc: Position your dominoes with care, because you only get one push. Set up the right chain and the whole line topples in one satisfying cascade.

name: COLOR SORT
desc: Pour colored liquid between tubes until every tube holds a single color. Easy to learn, but harder levels reward careful thinking about every pour.

name: NONOGRAM
desc: Use the number clues beside every row and column to work out which squares to fill. Get it right and a hidden pixel picture appears. A relaxing logic puzzle for patient solvers.

name: JIGSAW RELAX
desc: Drag loose pieces into place and watch a peaceful picture slowly come together. There's no pressure and no timer, just a quiet puzzle to unwind with.

name: Laser Dodge
desc: Sweeping laser beams cut across the arena and you have nowhere to stand still. Slip through the gaps as the beams get faster and more frequent. Survive as long as you can.

name: Ninja Dash
desc: Leap between two walls as a ninja racing upward through a gauntlet of spikes. Tap to jump across, time each leap to dodge hazards, and grab coins along the way. One mistimed jump ends the run.

name: Orb Catcher
desc: Orbs rain from above and your basket is the only thing catching them. Collect good orbs for points, snatch golden ones for a bonus and steer clear of bombs. The longer you last, the faster they fall.

name: Blade Slice
desc: Fruit is thrown across the screen and your finger is the blade. Slash cleanly through it, chain slices together for combo bonuses and keep away from the bombs. Fast hands win the round.

name: Gravity Flip
desc: Run a corridor where up and down are a matter of timing. Flip gravity to switch between the floor and the ceiling, threading through spikes and gaps as the pace picks up.

name: Bullet Storm
desc: Bullets pour in from every side of the screen and you control a single dot. Read the patterns, slip through the gaps and stay alive as the barrage thickens. Your score is how long you survive.

name: Platform Jumper
desc: Bounce your way up an endless tower of moving platforms. Line up each jump carefully, because missing a landing means a long fall. How high can you climb?

name: Pixel Runner
desc: Sprint forward through an endless course, jumping and ducking past obstacles that come at you faster the longer you survive. A simple one-more-try runner built around quick reactions.

name: Chain Reactor
desc: A field of floating nodes is waiting for a spark. Choose one to detonate and watch the explosion ripple through the others. The more nodes caught in a single chain, the bigger the score, so timing is everything.

name: Rocket Dash
desc: Pilot a rocket through a series of narrow openings in the walls ahead. The scroll speed keeps rising, and a single clipped wall ends your flight.

name: TAP RUSH
desc: A frantic 15-second burst of pure speed. Targets pop up across the screen and every tap you land adds to your total. Quick hands and sharp eyes will get you the highest score.

name: LASER DASH
desc: Sprint down a corridor lined with sweeping laser beams. Time your weaving carefully, because each beam is a one-hit mistake.

name: TURBO TAP
desc: Targets appear and the clock is already running. Tap as many as you can before time hits zero in a pure test of reflexes.

name: ASTEROID RUN
desc: Fly your ship through a dense asteroid belt where one hit is all it takes. Read the field ahead, slip through the gaps and survive the run.

name: BLADE FALL
desc: Blades drop from above while coins are scattered below. Sidestep the steel, grab what you can and keep going as the fall rate keeps rising.

name: NEON JUMP
desc: Platforms start fading the moment you land on them. Keep hopping forward from one to the next before the floor disappears beneath you.

name: VOLLEY BLITZ
desc: A frantic one-button rally where the ball never stops coming. Time each hit to keep it off your side as the pace builds.

name: SPIKE SURGE
desc: Spikes rise from every wall and the safe space keeps shrinking. Move fast, find the gaps and survive as long as you can.

name: DASH CLASH
desc: Charge up a dash and burst through barriers before they close in on you. Release too early and you'll be crushed.

name: PIXEL DUEL
desc: Two players share one keyboard in a head-to-head showdown. Player 1 uses W/S and Space, Player 2 uses the arrow keys and Enter. First to five wins bragging rights.

name: Rooftop Rumble
desc: Step onto a wind-swept rooftop and settle a score the old-fashioned way. Chain light and heavy strikes, read your opponent's guard, and time your counters in a fast one-on-one duel against a friend or the CPU. First fighter to land three knockouts takes the skyline.

name: Neon Sprint
desc: Hit the throttle on a neon-lit highway that never stops bending. Weave through traffic, clip past roadside hazards and hold your line as the pace climbs. You get three crashes before the run is over, so every overtake counts.

name: Circuit Snake
desc: A glowing circuit board is your arena and you are the signal running through it. Eat to grow longer, but every pickup makes the board tighter and your own tail more dangerous. One wrong turn into a wall or yourself ends the run.

name: Neon Pong
desc: The original two-paddle duel, rebuilt in neon. Face off against a sharp AI opponent where angle and timing decide every rally, and first to seven wins. Shut it out 7-0 for a special achievement.

name: Stack Surge
desc: Drop each block at just the right moment to build a tower toward the clouds. Anything hanging off the edge is sliced away, so the platform keeps shrinking as precision slips. See how high you can go before you run out of block.

name: Bot Defense
desc: A relentless horde of zombies is shambling in from the edge of the screen. Run, gun and drop barricades in a side-scrolling survival defense where every wave is bigger than the last. Outlast the night to earn your place on the leaderboard.

name: AIM TRAINER
desc: A single target bounces around the arena and your job is to hit it as many times as possible in 20 seconds. Great for sharpening mouse accuracy and tracking.

name: TANK BARRAGE
desc: Take control of a tank on a battlefield full of enemy armor and turrets. Move, aim and fire to clear the zone while staying out of the crossfire.

name: SNIPER ALLEY
desc: Moving targets cross your scope against a running clock. Line up each shot, lead your aim and make every bullet count.

name: DRIFT KING
desc: Slide through hairpin turns and rack up style points for every clean drift. Finish the lap with the highest score to claim the crown.

name: MECHA BRAWL
desc: Climb into a heavy mech and fight rival machines in close quarters. Manage your position, time your attacks and outlast the opposition.

name: ARROW STORM
desc: From the castle wall, loose arrow after arrow into the advancing horde. Aim well and keep up your rate of fire to hold the walls.

name: GRID RACER
desc: A stripped-down vector racing track with one goal: beat the ghost lap. Brake late, hit every apex and shave off the milliseconds.

name: CHESS DUEL
desc: Sit down against an adaptive AI in a full game of chess. Plan ahead, set traps and see if you can outwit it.

name: BOMBER RAID
desc: Drop bombs strategically to trap your opponents inside a maze arena. Think about blast ranges and escape routes, or your own bombs will catch you too.

name: STAR PILOT
desc: Dogfight enemy fighters over a scrolling starfield. Manage your shields and weapons, keep moving and stay alive.

name: PIT STOP PRO
desc: The car pulls into the pit lane and every second counts. Service all four tires under pressure, then release the car right on the pit window.

name: REACTION LIGHTS
desc: Five red lights stare back at you on the grid. When they go out, react instantly, because jumping the start costs you the race.

name: APEX HUNTER
desc: Guide the car through the apex gate and learn what a proper racing line feels like. Smooth, early and precise is the fastest way around.

name: PARKING MASTER
desc: Ease a car into a marked bay using throttle and steering. Nail it cleanly and you'll feel a little more like a professional driver.

name: DRAG LAUNCH
desc: Launch hard off the line, keep the revs in the sweet spot and shift through the gears. Reach 60 MPH faster than your last run.

name: RACE SETUP LAB
desc: Adjust front and rear aero, brake bias and ride height to find a balanced baseline. A hands-on look at how small setup changes alter how a race car behaves.
